title.description: The title of the page that browses the documents by folder, and the name of the top of the content in the trail of folders over them.

description.description: The line under the title of the page that browses the content: what it holds. The home page, About Us and the connect page are not among the documents: they are under Site.

allView.description: The name of the view of the content's browser that the admin starts with: every folder and document of the folder that is open, in their own order, with nothing searched for. Shown as the first tab over the browser, beside the views a user has saved.

new.description: The button that opens the form of a new document, and the title of that form's dialog.

newDescription.defaultMessage: Created in the current folder. You can add content after saving.
newDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new document: where the document is filed, and that its content is added after it is saved.

notFound.description: The error shown when the address of a page of the content names neither a folder nor a document: one of its names is not there, or no longer is.

page.description: The tab of a document's own page in the admin that holds its metadata and what is written on it.

type.description: The heading of the column of the content's browser for a document's media type (its MIME type), such as image/png, which is what kind of document it is.

size.description: The heading of the column of the content's browser for how much a document holds, and for a folder how much everything under it holds, shown as a file size.

newFolder.description: The button that opens the form of a new folder, and the title of that form's dialog.

newFolderDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that adds a new folder: where the folder is made.

folderName.description: The label of the field for a folder's name.

rename.description: The action on a folder's row that opens the form of its name.

renameFolder.description: The title of the dialog that renames a folder.

renameFolderDescription.defaultMessage: The folder’s contents are not affected.
renameFolderDescription.description: The line under the title of the dialog that renames a folder: what a new name leaves as it is.

move.description: The action on a document's or a folder's row that picks it up, to be put down in another folder.

moving.defaultMessage: Moving {name}. Open the destination folder, then choose Move here.
moving.description: What the page says over the folders while a document or a folder is picked up to be moved, and what to do next; “Move here” is the button that finishes the move. `name` is the document's title or the folder's name.

confirmMany.defaultMessage: Delete {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}? This cannot be undone.
confirmMany.description: The question asked before the documents and folders selected in the content's browser are deleted together. `count` is how many are selected, documents and folders alike.

moveHere.description: The button that puts what was picked up down in the folder that is open.
